tunnelConfig.fileFirst: Save your configuration here. The saved pair takes priority; environment variables are used only when no pair is saved.
tunnelConfig.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the saved key
tunnelConfig.storage: The key is stored unencrypted in secrets/tunnel-config.json in the local application data directory. It is never returned to the UI; the input clears on submission.
tunnelConfig.useEnvironment: Clear saved configuration and use environment
tunnelConfig.saved: Saved. Applies on the next connection start; stop and restart an active tunnel to use it.
tunnelConfig.sourceInvalid: Saved configuration is unreadable or invalid. Save it again or clear it. Environment fallback is disabled until repaired.
workspace.stopToRetry: Stop this tunnel, then start it again. If it still fails, check configuration below and the network proxy in Settings.
workspace.description: Your projects, ready for AI. Prepare your workspace, manage connections, and see what needs attention.
workspace.prepareHint: Choose a folder and start the runtime.
workspace.verifyHint: In ChatGPT, ask: List WebCodex projects, find my selected project and list its top-level files. If it is empty, report that.
workspace.handoffOne: Use Copy Tunnel ID above, or select the ID and copy it manually.
workspace.handoffTwo: Choose Tunnel in the ChatGPT connection setup, enter your Tunnel ID, and select None for authentication.
locale.label: Language
operation.cancelNote: Stopping the current operation does not automatically repeat steps whose outcome is still unconfirmed.
operation.localSetup: Setting up WebCodex on this computer
operation.remoteSetup: Connecting to the existing WebCodex Server
home.connectionObserved: A real ChatGPT WebCodex call to the current project has been observed.
home.runnerExplanation: The Runner executes work for projects on this computer.
home.connectionRemoteReady: The Server endpoint is verified for a ChatGPT connection.
home.connectionLocalReady: Runtime is healthy. Desktop is not managing external reachability; that does not mean ChatGPT is unavailable.
home.connectionTunnelReady: OpenAI Secure Tunnel is locally ready and waiting for ChatGPT to connect.
home.connectionUnverified: Desktop has not observed a real ChatGPT project call yet; that does not prove an external connection is unavailable.
home.runtimeOwnership: Desktop stops only processes it started. Existing user-managed processes are left alone.
clipboard.tunnelId: OpenAI Tunnel handoff copied to the clipboard.
clipboard.bearer: Temporary connection credential copied to the clipboard.
clipboard.sensitiveUrl: Temporary connection URL copied to the clipboard.
clipboard.copied: Connection handoff copied to the clipboard.
readiness.tunnelReadyWaitingForChatGpt: OpenAI Secure Tunnel ready; waiting for ChatGPT
action.startOrReconnectService: Start or reconnect the WebCodex Service.
action.startRunner: Start the Runner and wait for it to connect.
action.addOrReloadProject: Prepare and activate the selected project.
action.chooseConnection: Choose a ChatGPT connection in Connection.
action.checkConnection: After connecting in ChatGPT, verify the connection with one real project read.
action.restoreClipboard: Restore clipboard access, then restart the connection.
first.title: How do you want to use this computer?
first.description: Choose a project, prepare the runtime, and let your AI client get to work.
first.localDescription: For everyday use. Choose your project and Desktop will prepare its runtime on this computer.
first.remoteDescription: Already have a team or self-hosted Server? Connect it to use projects on this computer.
first.shareDescription: Start a temporary one-project session that ends together when you stop it.
setup.localDescription: First, choose the actual project folder. Desktop will prepare its runtime and verify that the project is ready.
setup.remoteDescription: The Server stays remote. Desktop enrolls and supervises only this computer's Runner.
setup.shareDescription: Connect one project temporarily. Stopping the share also ends its temporary runtime.
setup.serverUrlHelp: Enter the http(s) origin of the existing WebCodex Server.
setup.reuseEnrollmentHelp: Desktop will reuse this computer's existing connection to the Server; the new project does not need another login code.
setup.pairingCodeHelp: The code is used only for this pairing attempt and is cleared from the UI immediately after submission.
provider.openaiDescription: OpenAI Secure Tunnel when already configured
setup.projectRequired: Choose the real directory ChatGPT should use before starting setup.
setup.advancedEnrollmentHelp: Shared key and existing profile remain owned by the canonical webcodex connect lifecycle. Desktop does not copy bootstrap or admin credentials. Full GUI integration remains a D3 item.
setup.verifying: Desktop is verifying the real Service, Runner, and project state.
powershell7.title: PowerShell 7 is recommended
powershell7.fallbackAvailable: pwsh.exe was not detected. WebCodex will keep using Windows PowerShell 5.1 as a compatibility fallback, so setup is not blocked. After PowerShell 7 is installed, newly started Runners prefer pwsh.exe by default.
powershell7.fallbackUnavailable: Neither pwsh.exe nor the Windows PowerShell compatibility fallback was detected. Install PowerShell 7 before starting the local Runner.
powershell7.restartHint: If a new installation is still not detected, fully quit and reopen WebCodex to refresh its process environment.
setup.connectChatGptAfterSetupHelp: Starts OpenAI Secure Tunnel automatically and remembers this choice for the next Desktop launch.
setup.reloadProjectHelp: Desktop reapplies exact project access and activates it on the current Runner; only a legacy or incompatible Runner needs to be refreshed.
project.title: Projects on this computer
project.description: Desktop only manages folders you explicitly register or choose; it does not scan sibling repositories or the whole disk.
project.none: No project has been configured yet.
connection.title: ChatGPT Connection
connection.description: External reachability is separate from WebCodex permissions. A secure tunnel does not grant additional execution authority.
connection.observedDescription: A real ChatGPT WebCodex call to the current project has been observed. This is tracked separately from Desktop-managed Tunnel state.
connection.notVerified: Desktop has not observed a ChatGPT call to the current project yet; this is not the same as “not connected.”
connection.localDescription: Keep the WebCodex runtime running without a Desktop-managed ChatGPT Tunnel. Other existing connection paths are not disabled.
connection.openaiDescription: Connect ChatGPT through the official OpenAI Secure Tunnel.
connection.waitingForChatGpt: The local Tunnel is ready and waiting for ChatGPT. After connecting, use one real project read as the final verification.
connection.tunnelHandoffNeedsAction: Secure tunnel is running, but the connection handoff still needs attention
connection.runtimeRequired: Make the local WebCodex Service, Runner, and project ready first.
connection.openaiNotConfigured: Required OpenAI Tunnel configuration is not currently detected.
connection.quickShareManaged: The current connection belongs to the temporary Quick Share session.
activity.title: Recent runtime activity
activity.description: A bounded, secret-redacted history of Desktop lifecycle events. Raw terminal output is not mirrored here.
activity.noMatches: No matching activity. Adjust your search or filters.
activity.processObservationFailed: Desktop could not observe the managed process
activity.remoteConnecting: Connecting to the existing WebCodex Server
activity.remoteConnected: This computer is connected to the existing WebCodex Server
activity.quickShareStarting: Starting the temporary Quick Share runtime
activity.regularTunnelReady: OpenAI Secure Tunnel is locally ready; waiting for ChatGPT
activity.operationCancelRequested: Stop requested for the current Desktop operation
settings.title: Desktop settings
settings.description: Language, background startup, connection settings, and diagnostics.
settings.launchAtLoginHelp: Starts WebCodex in the background. Your existing runtime preferences decide whether the local runtime and ChatGPT connection are restored.
tunnelConfig.title: OpenAI Tunnel configuration detection
tunnelConfig.processScope: The checks below show whether the effective configuration is complete, without displaying secret values.
tunnelConfig.restartRequired: If you just set environment variables: closing the window only hides WebCodex in the tray/menu bar and does not refresh process environment. Fully quit WebCodex, then start it again, or launch it from a Terminal that already has those variables loaded.
tunnelConfig.macosShell: macOS: apps launched from Finder / Dock do not read ~/.zshrc. Recheck does not execute shell startup scripts either.
settings.tunnelProxyAutoHelp: Automatic mode prefers Desktop proxy environment settings, then detects the Windows system proxy; a detected local loopback proxy can also be used for Tunnel traffic.
settings.tunnelProxyCustomHelp: HTTP/HTTPS proxy without embedded credentials, for example http://127.0.0.1:7890. This affects OpenAI Tunnel only.
settings.binariesPending: Binaries are checked when setup or diagnostics first needs them.
error.binaryAction: Check the source-matched WebCodex binaries, then retry.
error.serverAction: Check Server status and network reachability, then retry.
error.runtimeAction: Restore the WebCodex Service, Runner, and project readiness, then retry.
error.runnerAction: Check the Runner connection to the Server, then retry.
error.projectAction: Use Activate project. Desktop will reapply exact project access and converge the project on the current Runner.
error.pairingAction: Enter the wc_pair_… code issued by the existing Server.
error.enrollmentAction: Check the Server and enrollment details, then retry.
error.tunnelAction: Check OpenAI Tunnel configuration and network access, then retry.
error.processTitle: Managed process could not start or stop
error.processAction: Check Activity and confirm the WebCodex binaries are executable, then retry.
error.contractTitle: Desktop and WebCodex contracts do not match
error.contractAction: Make sure Desktop and all three WebCodex binaries use the same source revision.
error.topologyTitle: This operation is not supported by the current runtime topology
error.topologyAction: Use Local Full Runtime, or manage external reachability on the remote Server.
error.operationBusyTitle: Another Desktop operation is still running
error.operationBusyAction: Wait for the current operation to finish, or stop it first.
error.operationStaleAction: Refresh state before stopping the operation you currently observe.
error.operationCancelledAction: Observe the current state before retrying any step whose outcome was not confirmed.
tunnelConfig.invalidInput: Enter a valid Tunnel ID (letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens) and an API key without spaces.
tunnelConfig.saveFailed: Could not save configuration. Check write access to the local application data directory and retry.
connection.copyFailed: Copy failed. Retry or select the Tunnel ID above and copy it manually. No restart is needed.
settings.tunnelProxyAutoHelpLocal: Uses the Desktop environment proxy first, then detects running local proxies.
